source_message:
fix(gap3): scp promptfoo.yaml instead of git clone on GMKtec

- deploy-gap3-promptfoo.sh: replace git clone with scp Legion→GMKtec
  target: /data/banxe/promptfoo/compliance/training/promptfoo.yaml
  cron entry sets DEVELOPER_DIR=/data/banxe/promptfoo
- run-promptfoo-eval.sh: auto-detect DEVELOPER_DIR (git repo or scp path)
  git push conditional — skipped if not a git repo
